description: Search Signed's public angel investor directory by keyword: a name, a login, or a word from an investor's bio or investment description ("climate", "former founder", "pre-seed"). A query that names a sector also matches investors who list that sector. Only public profiles are searched. Add sector or check_size to narrow the hits; use list_investors to browse a facet without a keyword.

check_size.description: Only investors writing checks in this range. Takes the slug (10k-25k) or the label ($10K-$25K); list_check_sizes has both.

q.description: Search text, matched against name, login, bio, investment description, and sector names and slugs.

sector.description: Only investors who list this sector. Takes the slug (devtools, fintech, health); list_sectors has the full set with names.

name: search_investors
